Case A: Source `{id:"r1", note absent}` serializes to `{"id":"r1"}`. Reconstruction yields `id:"r1"` with `note` absent. Semantic equality is preserved. Byte equality is applicable only to the exact supplied text and is preserved for this case.

Information-loss assessment: None is specified for these cases. Presence of `note` is distinguishable: omission represents absence, while `"note":""` represents a present empty string.

Ambiguity notes: No additional ambiguity is supplied. Byte equality is not a general claim beyond the exact serialized texts given.
